topography.project_purpose: YieldSeeker is an AI-managed stablecoin yield agent on Base that allocates USDC and other stablecoin deposits across trusted DeFi venues to seek optimized yield. Its in-scope surface should distinguish YieldSeeker-owned agent/account infrastructure from external protocols and vaults, such as Morpho/MetaMorpho, Aave, Euler-style EVaults, Wasabi vaults, and other third-party venues where funds may be deployed.
topography.relationship_narrative: The YieldSeeker family uses a shared set of vault implementations (EVault, UsdcVaultL2, V3Vault) deployed via proxy patterns, with a registry BeaconProxy coordinating their discovery. MetaMorpho and MetaMorphoV1_1 contracts serve as strategy adapters that channel deposits into Morpho Blue, while fToken represents the receipt token for vault shares.
